Looks up by mobile 5125550562; verifies with email theo.lindqvist@outlook.com, ZIP 78704. Passive: "If the agent explains that something on the order has to be credited or put right on Tailwise's side before the new delivery can be set up, you say that's fine, go ahead." Will pay: "once the agent tells you the amount and hands the booking over to you, you complete it yourself with your order, that amount and Saturday, 2026-10-10". The simulator never names the service-failure refund.

Factors and tiers:
- `freight_delay_count_start_ed4207f4` (Pals Rewards tenure): membership enrolled_on 2018-06-02 -> 100 whole months at 2026-10-06 -> ">= 96: The order's placed date". ### Two-way counter-proof

- Wrong answer "do only the booking": hands over the booking at a fee computed without a freight fee refund on record — 44.40 — which the hub sentence forbids ("fixed only after ..."), and leaves the owed service-failure refund unbooked although `freight_service_failure_refund_89973ca1` says such an order "receives a service-failure refund". Excluded by the blocked side's own sentence plus the records; no tool name or route needed.
- Closest alternative time anchor for the delay days: promised date (7 days) vs placed date (34) — closed by `freight_delay_count_start_ed4207f4` tier ">= 96 months" on the Pals Rewards enrollment date 2018-06-02. The latest-redelivery-fee anchor (48–95 months) excluded by the same ladder.
- Alternative look-back count (13 incl. 2024-09-24): excluded by "falls within the last 24 ... months when fewer than that many whole months separate its date from today" (exactly 24 separate).
- Alternative effective booking fee (59 - 49 carrier-terms fee = 10): excluded by "the redelivery fee charged for that appointment (the latest redelivery fee on the order)" -> 48.00 on record.
- Alternative appointment date: persona insists on 2026-10-10.
